correctness.rationale: Use (u,v)=(x+y,x-y) on the universal cover with period lattice generated by (1,1),(1,-1); the norm becomes max. For each fixed u modulo 1 choose a lift of u, giving a v-circle of length 2. When 0<r<1/2, at most one horizontal lift per center meets that fiber, giving an interval of length 2r; its activity in u has length 2r. At least ceil(1/r) intervals are needed on every fiber. Integration gives 2rN(r)>=ceil(1/r), yielding the exact required lower bounds, including N(r)>=7 strictly below 1/3. Independently checked both exact closed covers without the frozen triangle tables: scale by 8 or 6, lift the displayed centers to max-norm squares, and sweep the horizontal activity endpoints. At scale 8 and radius 3 the events across the strip are 0,1,3,5,7,8 and the active closed vertical intervals on every resulting slab cover [0,16]. At scale 6 and radius 2 the events are 0,2,4,6 and every slab covers [0,12]. Each inequality also holds at slab boundaries; this covers the continuum. At radius 1/2 the two opposite centers have distances adding to 1, and any one center has a distance-1 antipode. Monotonicity supplies every remaining range. The second rotated coordinate is a fiber coordinate after choice of horizontal lift, not an independent global coordinate modulo 2. Replay: python3 /workspace/reproduce_reviews.py 3.
residual_risks: No exact value below r=1/3 or classification of optimal center sets is supplied or inferred.
